name: seize_the_spoils_cannot_be_cast_without_a_card_to_discard_as_its_additional_cost
notes: Printed: 'As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.' Seat 0 holds only Seize the Spoils (a spell cannot discard itself as its own cost: it is on the stack by then) and has the mana for it, with two cards on top of its library. The cast is refused: nothing is drawn, no Treasure is made, the spell stays in hand and the mana stays in the pool. With a second card in hand the same cast works (B08_1).
